rationale: While NQ Leaf 4 is solidly positive (+0.57A net pooled 2023-2024; +$66,800 net dollars), both ES and YM suffer large negative net expectancies (-1.03A on ES; -0.84A on YM) under the canonical C1 lifecycle. Combining NQ with ES and YM dilutes and destroys NQ's net edge, resulting in a net negative combined portfolio. Therefore, Leaf 4 cannot be ported across instruments as a naive multi-index portfolio.
